# OakFox

> Sustainable design studio based in West Lancashire, UK. Founded by Nathan James Entwistle, OakFox helps independent businesses and international brands grow through considered brand identity, accessible web development, marketing, and green web hosting — with sustainability woven into every decision and proven, not just claimed (verified green hosting, original ecological research). Dedicated ecology reporting and automation is our sister venture, EcoScribe (https://ecoscribe.co.uk).

## About

- Name: OakFox (legal name: OakFox Limited)
- Founded: 2025
- Founder: Nathan James Entwistle (designer and developer with 15+ years experience)
- Location: West Lancashire, United Kingdom

## Services

- **[Branding](https://oakfox.co.uk/services/branding)** — sustainable brand identity, naming, voice, and guidelines.
- **[Web Design](https://oakfox.co.uk/services/web-design)** — accessible, considered website design and design systems.
- **[Development](https://oakfox.co.uk/services/development)** — fast, static-first web builds on verified renewable-powered hosting.
- **[Copywriting](https://oakfox.co.uk/services/copywriting)** — website copy, campaign copy, brand voice.
- **[Marketing](https://oakfox.co.uk/services/marketing)** — strategy, content, email, organic social, SEO — no greenwashing.
- **[Green Web Hosting](https://oakfox.co.uk/services/green-web-hosting)** — managed, renewable-powered UK hosting with free migration.
- **[Environmental](https://oakfox.co.uk/services/environmental)** — sustainability built into every project (verified green hosting, original ecological research). Dedicated ecology reporting & automation (PEA, BNG, SFI) is our venture EcoScribe — https://ecoscribe.co.uk.

## Locations

- [Ormskirk](https://oakfox.co.uk/locations/ormskirk): Independent retail, hospitality, professional services — 10 minutes from the studio.
- [Burscough](https://oakfox.co.uk/locations/burscough): Studio location — food producers, artisan makers, village hospitality.
- [Southport](https://oakfox.co.uk/locations/southport): Coastal town — hospitality, cultural, retail.
- [Preston](https://oakfox.co.uk/locations/preston): Central Lancashire — professional services, creative, university.
- [Manchester](https://oakfox.co.uk/locations/manchester): B2B software, creative, hospitality — 45 minutes east.
- [Lancashire](https://oakfox.co.uk/locations/lancashire): Full county coverage — hospitality, agriculture, ecology, retail.

## Selected work

- [Aigéan](https://oakfox.co.uk/portfolio/aigean): Strategic branding, marketing, and sustainability work for a Michelin-quality Irish seafood restaurant in Sandymount, Dublin.
- [CubTrack](https://oakfox.co.uk/portfolio/cubtrack): Full product design, development, and marketing for a baby and toddler tracking app.
- [Jennifer Lane](https://oakfox.co.uk/portfolio/jennifer-lane): Website refresh for the award-winning author and green witch, timed to coincide with a book launch.
- [Roll](https://oakfox.co.uk/portfolio/roll): Brand identity, in-store experience, and wholesale support for an artisan bakery and coffee shop in Bowness, Lake District.

## Working with OakFox

OakFox takes on a small number of projects each quarter to ensure every client gets considered attention. Typical engagements include brand identities, full website design and build, ongoing marketing, and managed green web hosting. Every project is shaped by a simple belief: brands that respect the planet perform better, last longer, and matter more.

To start a project, use the contact form at https://oakfox.co.uk/contact.
